mission_goal: Flesh out FFMx 44.4 (44× force per token, 0.54× cost) with exact mechanics, rocket physics, escape velocity, bee/apiary literature with full Vancouver citations.

lane_1_data_analyst.task: Break down FFMx formula into components: Discovery×Depth×Parallelization÷Cost. Show exact numbers from faerie2 session data (277K tokens, 9 manifests → 70 missions, 2.2× efficiency gain). Cite baseline metrics. Write manifest with dashboard_line + next_task_queued pointing to lane_2.

lane_2_research_analyst.task: Research real apiary/apiology literature: bee swarm intelligence (Seeley, Bonabeau), stigmergy in colonies (Camazine), coordination without central command. Gather 8-12 peer-reviewed sources with full citations (Vancouver format). Write as markdown table with URLs. Leave breadcrumb manifest pointing to lane_3.

lane_3_ai_engineer.task: Explain escape velocity, rocket staging (Tsiolkovsky equation), context burn rate as thrust, piston waves as stage separation. Use Kármán line analogy (100km boundary). Map directly to faerie2 W1/W2/W3 burn profile. Write technical section with equations. Manifest points to lane_4.

lane_4_documentation_engineer.task: Synthesize lanes 1-3 into coherent report structure: [Headline] FFMx Explained → [Section 1] Formula Breakdown (lane_1 data) → [Section 2] Bee Intelligence Parallels (lane_2 literature) → [Section 3] Rocket Physics Frame (lane_3 equations) → [Conclusion] Biosemiotic Emergence. Embed all Vancouver citations with in-text links. Write final narrative. Manifest final status.

cross_reference_schema.artifact_discovery: Agent reads prior lane outputs from forensics/artifacts/2026-04-28/ by grepping investigation_label or task_id
cross_reference_schema.manifest_chaining: Each manifest contains next_task_queued bearing; agent reads filesystem for next work without messaging
cross_reference_schema.citation_pool: Shared in-bundle JSON; each agent appends Vancouver citations to forensics/bundles/2026-04-28/citations-pool.jsonl (append-only, no locking needed)
cross_reference_schema.compass_bearing: N=blocked, S=proceed downstream, E=parallel, W=contradiction. Lanes use S (proceed) to chain sequentially, E if parallel paths exist

baseline_facts.interpretation: 44× the force output of vanilla Claude per token spent, at 54% of vanilla's computational cost

faerie2_session_metrics.efficiency_source: fresh_context_per_manifest (cleaner reasoning, direct dispatch path) vs competing_history

citation_template.url_requirement: Every citation must include DOI or full URL

spawn_bundle_tweaks.zero_latency_design: All agents receive full bundle at once (no sequential dispatch). Each agent's next_task_queued points to manifest path they expect next agent to write. Agents spawn in parallel (W1); manifest ordering creates effective serial execution without serialization overhead.
manifest_discovery_hints: Agent lane_2 (research-analyst) reads lane_1 output by: grep -r 'ffmx-formula-breakdown' forensics/artifacts/2026-04-28/
Agent lane_3 (ai-engineer) reads lane_2 citations from forensics/bundles/2026-04-28/citations-pool.jsonl
spawn_bundle_tweaks.prescan_gate: Before spawn, check if forensics/artifacts/2026-04-28/ffmx-* exists (modified <1h). If yes, skip (work in progress). If no, proceed.
spawn_bundle_tweaks.manifest_synchronization: No file locks. Agents write to unique paths: {agent-type}_{lane#}. Dashboard_line in each manifest shows completion %. Final report is lane_4 output only.
